svg.title: From source drift to a trusted release
svg.desc: Complete governance flow. Register approved sources, perform scheduled detection and review, map impact, propose evidence-linked updates, run checks, require human approval of an exact revision, publish a versioned release, monitor it, and retain bounded rollback evidence. A supplied observation dated 2026-09-20 reports scheduled corpus inspection but does not establish automatic provider-source comparison or end-to-end publication.
